title: VocabStore
description: Personal vocabulary store. Injected as STT prompt prefix to improve transcription of domain-specific terms.

version.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes.

term.description: The exact term or phrase to remember. e.g. 'Kharif season', 'Priya Sharma', 'drip irrigation'

phonetic_hint.description: Optional pronunciation hint for STT. e.g. 'kha-reef'

source.description: How this term was added: user typed it, auto-extracted from transcript, or user corrected a mistranscription

frequency.description: Number of times term has appeared across sessions

prompt_prefix_cache.description: Pre-built comma-separated string of top-N terms for injection into Whisper --initial_prompt. Regenerated on vocab update.
